name: Mercy USA for Aid and Development
mission: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is dedicated to alleviating human suffering and supporting individuals and their communities in their efforts to become more self-sufficient. Our philosophy is "Helping People Help Themselves".  Incorporated in the State of Michigan in 1988, Mercy-USA's projects focus on improving health, nutrition and access to safe water, as well as promoting economic and educational growth and providing disaster relief around the world.

rich_narrative.summary: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is an established humanitarian organization that has provided <cite id="1">critical health and nutrition services</cite> to vulnerable populations since <cite id="2">its founding in 1988</cite>. The charity focuses on high-impact interventions in conflict-affected regions, specifically targeting <cite id="3">children, pregnant women, and nursing mothers</cite> in Somalia and Syria. Their work is characterized by specialized medical programs, such as maintaining an <cite id="4">80% TB cure rate</cite> in Somalia and building <cite id="5">950 modular shelters</cite> for displaced families. While the organization demonstrates <cite id="6">strong fundraising efficiency</cite>, spending only $0.02 to raise every $1, it is currently navigating a period of financial contraction. Total revenue <cite id="7">declined from $54,067,823 in FY2023</cite> to <cite id="8">$34,922,507 in FY2024</cite>. Despite this 35% drop in annual revenue, Mercy-USA maintains a <cite id="9">92.33/100 overall score</cite> from Charity Navigator, reflecting a high standard of accountability and organizational culture. The charity is <cite id="10">zakat-eligible</cite>, directing funds toward the <cite id="11">fuqara and masakin</cite> (the poor and needy) through direct service delivery in Muslim-majority regions.
